Madagascar's famous Avenue of the Baobabs — are these centuries-old giant trees really worth travelling across Africa to see?
In this episode of Travelling Mantra, we explore Morondava, Madagascar, from its local streets and Indian Ocean beach to one of Africa's most iconic natural wonders — the Avenue of the Baobabs.
Our journey begins in Morondava, where we meet friendly local people, discover traditional transport, explore everyday Malagasy life and spend some unforgettable moments with children at the beach.
